summary: Added support for manually-solved reCAPTCHA tokens (Google reCAPTCHA v2 requires a human to solve it -- nothing to automate). Settings.recaptcha_token_path + BounScraperClient.recaptcha_token property (re-reads file fresh each access since tokens are single-use/~2min TTL, unlike cookies which are cached at client construction). flow.py's fetch_departments now includes ctl00$cphMainContent$gRecResp in its POST body -- this field was previously missing entirely, which is the actual root cause of reCAPTCHA blocks on that endpoint (confirmed by diffing a blocked vs a working curl from the user: identical except this field). Also added parse_curl_command() + a new 'boun-scrape import-curl' CLI command so a browser 'Copy as cURL' can be pasted directly (stdin or --file) to auto-extract cookies.txt + recaptcha_token.txt, per user request, instead of manual splitting.
author: devhax

summary: First step toward boun-archive integration (agreed plan: one-time backfill + ongoing granular delta/quota sync, current-term only, no full-history resync). Added QuotaSnapshot persistence (new quota_snapshots table, append-only log) since quota was previously live-only/never persisted -- capture is opt-in via capture_quota flag (default off) on execute_scrape_cycle/ScrapeTriggerRequest/--capture-quota CLI flag, since bulk quota-fetching is rate-limit/reCAPTCHA-sensitive against the portal. New GET /api/v1/feeds/quota-snapshots?term=X&after_timestamp=Y for incremental polling (ASC order, unlike deltas' DESC -- built for cursor-based sync, not recency display). Added the same after_timestamp filter to the existing GET /api/v1/feeds/deltas. Both new/modified feeds endpoints are still unauthenticated by design (matches courses/departments/terms) -- a shared-secret gate for machine-to-machine polling is deliberately deferred, not yet built.
author: devhax

summary: Completes the uncommitted session work (post-d894fc6) and commits it. Code-review fixes: data-loss root cause fixed — save_courses_and_slots used to DELETE all courses for a term before re-insert, so any department that failed to scrape that run had its previously-good data wiped; it now takes scraped_departments (TermScrapeResult from scrape_term_pipeline) and only replaces rows for departments that actually succeeded. Added execute_all_terms_cycle + --all-terms CLI flag (scrapes every portal term sequentially; per-term failure doesn't abort the rest). Added completed_departments column to scrape_runs (schema + additive _migrate_schema ALTER TABLE for pre-existing DBs; upsert and read paths carry it; run_to_dto already covered it). Fixed latent storage<->pipeline circular import: pipeline/__init__ eagerly re-exported exporter (which imports storage.repository) while repository imports pipeline.delta — broke isolated test-file collection (test_repository.py failed alone); exporter re-exports had zero consumers, dropped them. Regression tests: completed_departments survives save/reload round-trip via get_scrape_runs/get_latest_run AND survives the upsert-update path; old-schema DB upgrades in place via init_db migration with pre-existing rows reading back completed_departments=0. Full suite 214/214; all 16 test files pass in isolation (previously order-dependent).
author: devhax
